	rpx_econ_health_reward = yes
	add_to_variable = { rpx_econ_supply_var = -0.10 tooltip = supply_consumption_factor_tt }

			free_building_slots = {
				building = infrastructure
				size > 0
			}
			OR = {
				is_in_home_area = yes
				NOT = {
					owner = {
						any_owned_state = {
							free_building_slots = {
								building = infrastructure
								size > 0
							}
							is_in_home_area = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_building_construction = {

			level = 2

		}
